messages:
Maya (docs): Hey team — noticed the JSONL example in the console-observability quickstart has unescaped newlines in the `description` field which makes our bulk ingest return 400. example that breaks parser:
```json
{"metric":"request_latency","description":"p95
observed over 1m","value":123}
```

Sam (devex): Oof, that's nasty :grimacing: which file is this in? PR already?

Maya (docs): It's `docs/snippets/console-obsv/dashboard-example.jsonl` referenced by the quickstart. PR opened at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — I pushed a minimal fix that escapes `\n` and added a tiny docs-ci check to validate each JSONL line is parseable.

Alex (eng-runtime): Can you paste the fixed line so I can grep for similar patterns in other snippets?

Maya (docs): Sure — fixed example:
```json
{"metric":"request_latency","description":"p95\nobserved over 1m","value":123}
```
(note: `\n` literal inside the JSON string)

Cleo (product): Do we need a note in the migration guide? Some customers upload multi-line descriptions and our bulk tool used to accept raw newlines (bad), so this will change import behavior.

Sam (devex): Good catch. I added a short migration snippet to the docs PR showing a transformer for existing files: `python -c "import sys,json; print('\\n'.join(json.dumps(json.loads(line)) for line in sys.stdin))"` — that normalizes/escapes the lines.

Maya (docs): Also fixed a trailing comma the docs-ci flagged and force-pushed.

ci-bot: docs-ci / jsonl-lint failed on `docs/snippets/console-obsv/legacy-example.jsonl` — line 12 has an extra trailing comma.

Maya (docs): Fixed legacy-example too, updated commit.

Alex (eng-runtime): Quick grep across repo for `"description":` with raw newline patterns and patched two more tiny samples.

Sam (devex): Reviewing PR now :eyes: left a small comment about wording in the migration blurb.

ci-bot: All checks passed — docs-ci green.

Sam (devex): Approved. Will merge in ~5m if no objections. :thumbsup:

Cleo (product): No objections, thanks for the quick turnaround. Please ping support to watch for any import-related tickets.

Maya (docs): Merged — live in next site deploy. I'll ping infra to run a one-off import test on staging and drop a note in the migration doc about the escape requirement. :tada:
